title: Search filter panel
description: The gov.uk/search/all pattern: filter sidebar with date fields, topic checkbox tree, and apply button beside a results column. Observed live on GOV.UK.

components.reason: Topic/type facet checkboxes (instantiate one group per facet)

nesting: Two-column layout: filter panel (components 1-3) beside the results column (component 4, one per result)
validationOrder: Every filter checkbox has a for/id-linked label
Selected filters are reflected as removable tags or selected checkboxes on results pages
a11yNotes: Group facet checkboxes in fieldset+legend per facet
Date fields keep their visual labels
Results updates announced via a polite live region
agentPromptSequence: 1. Build the filter panel: one checkbox group per facet, date inputs for range filters
2. Add the apply button at the panel bottom
3. Render the results column with search-result-item per hit
4. State the result count before the results
